variant_samples.variant_description: Built around a solid brass weighted base, this contemporary counter top kitchen paper towel holder is designed to stay steady and help prevent tipping. Antique Bronze deepens this solid brass countertop paper towel holder. The freestanding design requires no wall mounting, so you can add paper-towel storage without drilling. A felt pad under the base helps protect any surface from scratches and helps keep your countertop clutter free. Crafted from brass and finished with a lifetime designer finish for corrosion-free, rust-free performance. Its crisp, clean, architectural styling echoes modern design, and it measures 5 inches in length. Includes one paper towel holder, backed by a Limited Lifetime Warranty. No assembly required.
